name: Grave Walker (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Nightblade 12, Path of the Eternal Night

Benefit: The nightblade gains the ability to shift between dead or dying creatures, the energy of their death serving as a focal point for her shadow magic. The nightblade can treat a corpse’s, a dying creature’s, or an undead creature’s space and any squares adjacent to it as if it were in dim light for the purpose of teleporting with her shadow shift ability.
